His eyes, once a piercing crimson, now held a soft, almost human glow, reflecting the screen of the modern device. The game before him was a first-person shooter, but it was not the usual fare of dark, shadowy environments and eerie silence. This game allowed the player to walk around in the sun, something Elias had not experienced in centuries.

Elias had always been fascinated by the concept of sunlight. As a vampire, he was bound by the ancient curse that kept him in the shadows, his skin turning to ash if he ventured too far into the light. But in this game, he could bask in the warmth of the sun, feel the gentle breeze on his skin, and see the world in vibrant colors. It was the closest thing he had to experiencing the day again.

The game was set in a bustling city, and Elias found himself drawn to the bustling life of the characters. He watched as they laughed, chatted, and went about their daily routines, all under the golden rays of the sun. He longed to join them, to feel the warmth on his face, to taste the air with his lips. But he knew he could never do that in the real world.

He was no longer Elias the vampire, but a character in the game, a human who could walk in the sun and feel the world around him.

"Can I play?" she asked, her voice filled with excitement.

Elias looked up, surprised by the interruption. He hesitated for a moment, then nodded. He handed her the controller, and she began to play, her fingers moving deftly across the buttons. She laughed and smiled, her joy infectious.
